title: Bernie Young's role as business-minded second trumpet, and the move to Chicago
summary: Young played second trumpet and handled business while Randolph led the section; after about three years at the Roof Garden the whole band moved to Chicago in 1929.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Well, what did Bernie Young play?
Was he the lead trumpet or were you?
Did he solo or was is sort of like a
No, he's more like business -- to carry the business and play second trumpet.
Yes, uh-huh. Wonderful thing. So, we stayed there for awhile. We stayed there until -- about three years at the Roof Garden, and then after, of course, then we came to Chicago.
What were those years at the Roof Garden? '25 through '29?
About '26, '27 and '28. '26 -- '27, '28 and '29. Then part of '29 then we came here to Chicago.
